name: Madame du Barry
source:
"...I can't lose to that Austrian girl at our first meeting. I have to be even fancier."

Born in France.
Hobby: Collecting Jewels
Likes: Luxurious Things
Dislikes: Poor People, Common People

Louie the 15th's public mistress.
She has a lot of pride and can't be settle down unless she is considered the best.
She boasts about bringing herself up from being a commoner to becoming the kings mistress.
She holds animosity towards [url=/c50768]Marie[/url] for not knowing herself.
